selection: Highest normal simulation TEST every 5 epochs, including epoch 0; development metric, no TEST gradients. Never choose a worse PT to force a sub-90 baseline.
architecture: Original rank64 shared head and original decoder; fixed existing blockwise optical alpha before gradients; no added branches or layers.
warmstart_caveat: Common original fullhead checkpoint was trained on original TRAIN and previously TEST-evaluated; not a fresh independent benchmark.
geometry: 17um input,10cm propagation,tanh(abs/.5),zero-preserving BMP round255a without peak rescale
hardware_contract: Normal 2000us/GainX4/wait240/verified ROI and direction; no artificial baseline degradation.
deployment: Lock best checkpoint then new six-layer TEST and independent TRAIN CCD. Changed upstream/phase never reuses prior CCD. Finetune only original decoder, TEST selection development/no TEST gradients.
protection: ABO/G5/prior G2 untouched, external upload paused. No new branch, worktree or project copy.
